name: Do I need building permits for interior remodeling in the Denver area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need building permits for interior remodeling in the Denver area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permits are generally required whenever a home improvement project alters the structural framing, electrical wiring, or plumbing lines of a house. Simple cosmetic updates—such as interior painting, replacing moldings, patching drywall, or swapping out existing tile surfaces—rarely need municipal building permits. However, room additions, basement finishes, and knocking down load-bearing walls must comply with local municipal building codes across the Denver metro area. A licensed general contractor reviews your design plans and arranges permits before demolition begins to ensure full code compliance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are required for framing, plumbing, and electrical changes, while surface updates like painting, drywall repairs, and finish trim generally do not need them.
